notes: Candidates only: nothing downloaded, uploaded, edited or probed in Studio. Creators restricted to ProSoundEffects, APMOfficial, DistrokidOfficial and Roblox per the owner's rule; individual uploaders and SoundEffectsRoblox were excluded. Music-typed results were rejected (for example DistrokidOfficial Music items such as 'Sub-Bass Ambient' and 'Power Cutz'). Durations are toolbox listings only: duration_verified is false everywhere, 0 or 1 values mean short or unknown, and the 3.5 s charge, 1 to 2 s flip and 8 s orb-hold lengths must be measured in Studio. Many library hits report listing type Unknown (Machine Hum, Command Room Tone, Death Rumble Hum, Metallic Glow Hum, Power Down-style takes, Synth Tone): their kind must be checked when probed, because the toolbox listing does not say SoundEffect. Licence basis is UNVERIFIED for every id in this file, the same basis as the e1 and phase C and D batches: the Creator Store and Roblox audio terms were not read in this run. No attribution-requiring item is in this file. Dropped: 120436235187042 'gojostartup' (SoundEffectsRoblox, not an allowed creator); 102816315467705 'Box Fan Hum for Sleep' (DistrokidOfficial, ambient fan noise, not an energy field, listed Unknown); all DistrokidOfficial and APMOfficial Music-typed results (drones, brown noise, lullabies). Thin roles: gravity_hum and orb_loop (no ProSoundEffects steady hum typed SoundEffect; the best are APM 'Machine Hum' and Unknown-typed ProSound hums, and orb_loop has no energy-field loop at all); orb_throw (no rocket or launch clip in the library, only rising swishes); gravity_perfect (only metal-bang and metal-impact takes for the bright ping, no true bright ping found); gravity_pulse (no ProSoundEffects sub-bass kick below 0.6 s; the picks are boom and thump impacts, longer than the band); orb_burst (no firework burst from an allowed creator; explosions and magic bursts only). Search phrasings that worked: 'rising whoosh', 'energy charge up', 'magic burst', 'energy burst', 'deep boom impact', 'metal stone slam', 'metal impact', 'power down', 'energy pass by sci fi', 'swoosh up', 'explosion boom big', 'sub bass boom' (returned only Music/individual hits). Phrasings with no allowed hits: 'generator hum', 'plasma hum', 'power core hum', 'electric hum loop', 'rocket launch whoosh', 'firework burst', 'magic orb'. The search tool intermittently returned HTTP 400 on some queries at limit 40, so every run used limit 30.
